# MSU College of Agriculture & Natural Resources

> > Michigan State University's College of Agriculture & Natural Resources (CANR) connects research, education, and Extension programs in agriculture, youth development, and natural resources across Michigan.

CANR houses MSU Extension and AgBioResearch, delivering science-based programs including Michigan 4-H youth development, agricultural research, workforce training, and community engagement initiatives. The college serves Michigan communities through Extension offices, youth programs, and partnerships with schools, farms, and local organizations.

## Key Topics

- MSU Extension
- Michigan 4-H
- Youth Development
- Michigan Agriculture
- AgBioResearch
- Workforce Development
- 4-H Apprenticeship
- Financial Literacy
- Animal Science
- Veterinary Science
- Civic Engagement
- Farm-to-School
- Volunteer Resources
- Advisory Groups
- Summer Camps

## College Overview

- [College of Agriculture & Natural Resources](https://www.canr.msu.edu): MSU CANR homepage featuring AgBioResearch and Extension programs

## 4-H Youth Development Programs

- [4-H Apprenticeship](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4-h-apprenticeship): Michigan 4-H apprenticeship program for youth workforce development
- [4-H Smart Money Contests](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4-h-money-smarts/index): Michigan 4-H financial literacy contests and workshops for youth
- [4-H Animal & Veterinary Science Camp](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_animal_veterinary_science_camp): MSU summer camp for teens exploring animal and veterinary science
- [4-H Biological Science](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_biological_science/index): Michigan 4-H programs in life sciences and animal science education
- [4-H Capitol Experience](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_capitol_experience): Annual Michigan 4-H civic engagement and public policy conference
- [4-H Advisory Group Support](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_advisory_group_support): Training and resources for Michigan 4-H advisory groups

## Financial Literacy & Competitions

- [Cash Composition Contest](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4-h-money-smarts/money-smart-kids-contest): Essay contest on financial literacy and fraud prevention for youth
- [Show Your Money Smarts Contest](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4-h-money-smarts/show-your-money-smarts-contest): Online financial literacy quiz competition for Michigan youth

## Specialized Programs & Camps

- [4-H Animal & Veterinary Science Camp Overview](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_animal_veterinary_science_camp/index): Hands-on pre-college camp for youth ages 13-17 at MSU
- [Capitol Experience Pre-Conference Activities](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_capitol_experience/pre_conference_activities): Pre-conference activities on Michigan government and civic engagement

## Resources & Toolkits

- [4-H Apprenticeship Student Resources](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4-h-apprenticeship/Apprenticeship-101/student-resources): Career exploration and apprenticeship resources for students
- [4-H Advisory Toolkit](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_advisory_group_support/advisory_toolkit): Templates and guides for 4-H advisory group management

## News & Updates

- [10 Cents a Meal News](https://www.canr.msu.edu/10-cents-a-meal/news): News on Michigan farm-to-school program and local food procurement
- [4-H Animal Evaluation News](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_animal_evaluation/news): Updates on livestock judging contests and animal evaluation programs
- [4-H Biological Science News](https://www.canr.msu.edu/4_h_biological_science/news): Updates on 4-H biological science programs and volunteer recognition
